_comment: Stub consent store for the Phase 0 prototype. The Flutter console will eventually toggle these; for now edit by hand. To DEMO REVOCATION, flip travel.read from true to false and re-run the agent's query -- the next call is refused. Phase 1 replaces this file with real ACL/ACP grants + Solid-OIDC token validation. A purpose just needs an entry here to be recognized at all (explicit opt-in) -- <purpose>/data/ under the POD root is tried automatically (the real solidpod app convention), falling back to context/<purpose>/. "path" is only needed to override both of those.
